paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: Paper reports first storage-ring search for ALPs using polarized deuteron beam at COSY, constraining the oscillating deuteron EDM component (d_AC) and ALP coupling constants over axion mass range 4.95-5.02 neV (spin precession freq ~121 kHz). Coupling type is AxionEDM (oscillating EDM d_AC). However, the provided paper content cuts off before the results section (Section IV) where the actual numerical upper limits on the oscillating EDM and axion coupling g_aNgamma are presented; no extractable (mass, coupling) data points are available in the given text. Feldman-Cousins 95% CL used.
